name: Bot Auto
sub: First fully humanless commercial truckload, Houston to Dallas
about: Houston-based autonomous trucking company founded in 2023 by Xiaodi Hou. In April 2026 they completed the first fully humanless over-the-road commercial truckload in US history, a 231-mile Houston-to-Hutchins run with no one in the cab and no remote operator.
metrics: Reports their humanless Houston–Dallas runs cost $1.89/mile against roughly $2.26 for a human-driven truck; 80 employees, 12 tractors, ~$40M raised; overnight driverless Houston–Dallas lane with Ryan Transportation from Spring 2026, insured through an A-rated Marsh program.
signal: First fully humanless commercial truckload, Houston-Dallas (Apr 2026)

sources.title: Driverless trucks take off in Texas: Bot Auto delivers first freight load
